mainEntity.name: When should an insurance agency consider implementing AEO strategies?

acceptedAnswer.text: An insurance agency should consider implementing AEO strategies when they want to increase their direct visibility in search results, particularly for informational queries. This is especially relevant if their target audience frequently uses voice search or relies on search engines for quick answers to insurance-related questions. It's also beneficial for agencies looking to establish themselves as authoritative sources of information in their local market. Implementing AEO can be a proactive step to adapt to evolving search engine algorithms and user behavior, moving beyond just ranking for competitive keywords.
acceptedAnswer.description: An insurance agency should implement AEO when aiming to increase direct search visibility for informational queries, especially if their audience uses voice search or seeks quick answers.
